title: What an AI Agent Actually Is
description:
What is an AI agent, actually? Everyone talks about them like there's a little brain that thinks and reasons and makes decisions, which is exactly why agents feel like hype instead of something practical. 

Here's the honest one-sentence version: an AI agent is just a language model that can use tools, running in a loop until it finishes a job. 

That's it. Everything else is a small detail.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer #programming
